messages.subject: RIself and scantwo
parts:
Hi:

Has anyone had success running a scantwo analysis with an "riself"
population?
I'm having some trouble and am wondering whether I've encountered a bug
or have a problem with my data.

The output from the scantwo run is missing all of the "chromosome with
same chromosome" (e.g., chromosome 1 vs. chromosome 1) LOD scores.

The analysis does seem to work with the same dataset if I consider the
population a BC.

Tom

Dear Tom,

It was a very simple bug. Use source() to load the attached code,
so that this modified version of the calc.pairprob() function is used
in place of the original. This fix will be incorporated into the next
version.

Thanks for letting me know about the problem.

karl
